s0001.literal: First year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on bingchen day, Zhao Shiyan and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to take charge of compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》.
s0001.idiomatic: First year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on bingchen day, Zhao Shiyan and Zhao Shi'an were ordered to take charge of compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》.

s0002.literal: Huaiqing Route suffered famine; four thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0002.idiomatic: Huaiqing Route suffered famine; 4,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0003.literal: On dingsi day, Mingzong's consorts Babusha, Yuelusha, and Buyan Khuladu were granted paper currency in varying amounts.
s0003.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Mingzong's consorts Babusha, Yuelusha, and Buyan Khuladu were granted paper currency in varying amounts.

s0004.literal: Privy council administrator Bertemur was made Liaodong Branch Secretariat left chancellor.
s0004.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Bertemur was made Liaodong Branch Secretariat left chancellor.

s0005.literal: On wuwu day, sealed edicts were issued instructing Yunnan.
s0005.idiomatic: On wuwu day, sealed edicts were issued instructing Yunnan.

s0006.literal: On xinyou day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0006.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0007.literal: The Huihui Bureau of Astronomy was ordered to chart the stars.
s0007.idiomatic: The Huihui Bureau of Astronomy was ordered to chart the stars.

s0008.literal: On renxu day, Zhongxing Route suffered famine; ten thousand shi of grain was sold for relief, and the poor were still granted bounty for their households.
s0008.idiomatic: On renxu day, Zhongxing Route suffered famine; 10,000 shi of grain was sold for relief, and the poor were still granted bounty for their households.

s0009.literal: On jiazi day, Yan Temür and Bayan both resigned their chancellor posts; the request was not granted, and Arong and Zhao Shi'an were still ordered to console and instruct them.
s0009.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Yan Temür and Bayan both resigned their chancellor posts; the request was not granted, and Arong and Zhao Shi'an were still ordered to console and instruct them.

s0010.literal: On dingmao day, Yunnan princes Tujian and wanhu Boqu, Ahe, Qiechao, and others rebelled, attacked Zhongqing Route, and took it; they killed surveillance commission officials, seized left chancellor Xindu and others, and compelled them to sign various documents.
s0010.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Yunnan princes Tujian and wanhu Boqu, Ahe, Qiechao, and others rebelled, attacked Zhongqing Route, and took it; they killed surveillance commission officials, seized left chancellor Xindu and others, and compelled them to sign various documents.

s0011.literal: On gengwu day, Shaoqi garrison and hawkery soldiers suffered famine; one month's grain was granted for relief.
s0011.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Shaoqi garrison and hawkery soldiers suffered famine; 1 month's grain was granted for relief.

s0012.literal: On xinwei day, central secretariat officials said: "The dates for the civil service examination metropolitan tests — the old regulation fixed them on the first, third, and fifth days of the second month; in recent years this was changed to the eleventh, thirteenth, and fifteenth.
s0012.idiomatic: On xinwei day, central secretariat officials said: "The dates for the civil service examination metropolitan tests — the old regulation fixed them on the 1st, 3rd, and 5th days of the second month; in recent years this was changed to the 11th, 13th, and 15th.

s0013.literal: We request that the old regulation be followed.
s0013.idiomatic: We request that the old regulation be followed.

s0015.literal: Hengyang Yao became bandits and plundered Xiangxiang Prefecture.
s0015.idiomatic: Hengyang Yao became bandits and plundered Xiangxiang Prefecture.

s0016.literal: On guiyou day, palace ordonnance commissioner Sadon was again made privy council administrator and jointly supervised Changning Commandery with the Qipchaq Office.
s0016.idiomatic: On guiyou day, palace ordonnance commissioner Sadon was again made privy council administrator and jointly supervised Changning Commandery with the Qipchaq Office.

s0017.literal: On yihai day, Yan Temür was granted one pawnshop.
s0017.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yan Temür was granted 1 pawnshop.

s0018.literal: Wen and Haizhou's Wendeng and Mouping counties suffered famine; three thousand shi of grain was granted for relief.
s0018.idiomatic: Wen and Haizhou's Wendeng and Mouping counties suffered famine; 3,000 shi of grain was granted for relief.

s0019.literal: On bingzi day, Hengzhou Route suffered famine; route superintendent Wang Bogong pawned his commission tally to an official for ten thousand shi of grain to relieve the famine.
s0019.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Hengzhou Route suffered famine; route superintendent Wang Bogong pawned his commission tally to an official for 10,000 shi of grain to relieve the famine.

s0020.literal: On dingchou day, Sanbaonu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Yingcheng, posthumous name Rongmin.
s0020.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Sanbaonu was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Yingcheng, posthumous name Rongmin.

s0021.literal: The Prince of Jing's son Tuotuomuer was summoned to court.
s0021.idiomatic: The Prince of Jing's son Tuotuomuer was summoned to court.

s0022.literal: Zhao Shiyan requested retirement; the request was not granted.
s0022.idiomatic: Zhao Shiyan requested retirement; the request was not granted.

s0023.literal: The central secretariat was ordered to make twenty jade belts and grant them to officials of the first rank.
s0023.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered to make 20 jade belts and grant them to officials of the first rank.

s0024.literal: Envoys were dispatched bearing one thousand five hundred taels of gold and five hundred taels of silver to transcribe Buddhist sutras at Hangzhou.
s0024.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched bearing 1,500 taels of gold and 500 taels of silver to transcribe Buddhist sutras at Hangzhou.

s0025.literal: The Great Xinglong Puming Monastery in Hainan was granted ten thousand ingots of notes to purchase perpetual-tenure land.
s0025.idiomatic: The Great Xinglong Puming Monastery in Hainan was granted 10,000 ingots of notes to purchase perpetual-tenure land.

s0026.literal: On wuyin day, one thousand qing of fields of the Longxi directorate-general were granted.
s0026.idiomatic: On wuyin day, 1,000 qing of fields of the Longxi directorate-general were granted.

s0027.literal: Jingxiang and elsewhere and Pingsong and elsewhere land-tax intendancies were established, both subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings.
s0027.idiomatic: Jingxiang and elsewhere and Pingsong and elsewhere land-tax intendancies were established, both subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings.

s0028.literal: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to use one hundred thousand ingots of salt-tax notes to relieve wandering people returning to their occupations.
s0028.idiomatic: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to use 100,000 ingots of salt-tax notes to relieve wandering people returning to their occupations.

s0029.literal: More than eight hundred Yao bandits raided Shikang County.
s0029.idiomatic: More than 800 Yao bandits raided Shikang County.

s0030.literal: On jimao day, Grand Medical Academy director Yeliya was enfeoffed Duke of Qin.
s0030.idiomatic: On jimao day, Grand Medical Academy director Yeliya was enfeoffed Duke of Qin.

s0031.literal: On gengchen day, the Gathered Jade Office was promoted to the Gathered Jade Inner Office, rank 3a; office commandant, deputy commandant, colonel of the office, and office secretary were appointed, still subordinate to the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academician Institute.
s0031.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Gathered Jade Office was promoted to the Gathered Jade Inner Office, rank 3a; office commandant, deputy commandant, colonel of the office, and office secretary were appointed, still subordinate to the Kui Zhang Pavilion Academician Institute.

s0032.literal: Minister of Rites Zhanzhan concurrently supervised affairs of the Gathered Jade Inner Office.
s0032.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Zhanzhan concurrently supervised affairs of the Gathered Jade Inner Office.

s0033.literal: On xinsi day, the Dadu land-tax intendancy was renamed the Office for Promoting Agriculture, the Jingxiang land-tax intendancy was renamed the Jingxiang Relief Agriculture Incense Household Intendancy, and the Pingjiang intendancy was renamed the Pingjiang Good Agriculture Intendancy.
s0033.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Dadu land-tax intendancy was renamed the Office for Promoting Agriculture, the Jingxiang land-tax intendancy was renamed the Jingxiang Relief Agriculture Incense Household Intendancy, and the Pingjiang intendancy was renamed the Pingjiang Good Agriculture Intendancy.

s0034.literal: Envoys were dispatched bearing three thousand ingots of notes to Gansu to purchase yak cattle.
s0034.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched bearing 3,000 ingots of notes to Gansu to purchase yak cattle.

s0035.literal: Haozhou suffered drought last year; one month's grain was granted for relief.
s0035.idiomatic: Haozhou suffered drought last year; 1 month's grain was granted for relief.

s0036.literal: Daming Route and Jiang-Zhe routes all reported drought last year; Yongping Route reported hail disaster last August.
s0036.idiomatic: Daming Route and Jiang-Zhe routes all reported drought last year; Yongping Route reported hail disaster last August.

s0037.literal: Qin-Shu commandery governor Li Bing was further enfeoffed as King Shengde Guangyu Yinghui; his son Erlang Shen was enfeoffed as King Yinglie Zhaohui Lingxian Renyou.
s0037.idiomatic: Qin-Shu commandery governor Li Bing was further enfeoffed as King Shengde Guangyu Yinghui; his son Erlang Shen was enfeoffed as King Yinglie Zhaohui Lingxian Renyou.

s0038.literal: Second month, on renwu new moon, Zhao Shi'an was made supervising censor-in-chief and Shi Weiliang was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.
s0038.idiomatic: Second month, on renwu new moon, Zhao Shi'an was made supervising censor-in-chief and Shi Weiliang was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.

s0039.literal: On guiwei day, privy council administrator Yan Bulin was further granted Palace Secretariat Grandee.
s0039.idiomatic: On guiwei day, privy council administrator Yan Bulin was further granted Palace Secretariat Grandee.

s0040.literal: The household assets of Zhang Gui's five sons were registered.
s0040.idiomatic: The household assets of Zhang Gui's 5 sons were registered.

s0041.literal: On yiyou day, the western monks Gawazangbu and Zanba'r Jianzang were both made pacification commissioners and commander-in-chief of U-Tsang and Tibetan territories.
s0041.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the western monks Gawazangbu and Zanba'r Jianzang were both made pacification commissioners and commander-in-chief of U-Tsang and Tibetan territories.

s0042.literal: Yunnan Lucchuan and other native officials came to present tribute goods.
s0042.idiomatic: Yunnan Lucchuan and other native officials came to present tribute goods.

s0043.literal: Yangzhou, Anfeng, Luzhou, and other routes suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes and fifty thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
s0043.idiomatic: Yangzhou, Anfeng, Luzhou, and other routes suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes and 50,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

s0044.literal: Zhending, Qi, Huang, and other routes; Runing Prefecture and Zheng Prefecture suffered famine; each was granted one month's grain for relief.
s0044.idiomatic: Zhending, Qi, Huang, and other routes; Runing Prefecture and Zheng Prefecture suffered famine; each was granted 1 month's grain for relief.

s0045.literal: On dinghai day, it was ordered that wealthy households in Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Henan, and elsewhere who transported grain might purchase office: in Jiangnan ten thousand shi earned rank 7a, in Shaanxi one thousand five hundred shi, in Henan two thousand shi, and in Jiangnan five thousand shi earned rank 7b, with other amounts graded in rank.
s0045.idiomatic: On dinghai day, it was ordered that wealthy households in Jiangnan, Shaanxi, Henan, and elsewhere who transported grain might purchase office: in Jiangnan 10,000 shi earned rank 7a, in Shaanxi 1,500 shi, in Henan 2,000 shi, and in Jiangnan 5,000 shi earned rank 7b, with other amounts graded in rank.

s0046.literal: Sichuan wealthy who could transport grain to Jiangling would follow the Henan precedent; those unwilling to serve but requesting enfeoffment for parents were permitted.
s0046.idiomatic: Sichuan wealthy who could transport grain to Jiangling would follow the Henan precedent; those unwilling to serve but requesting enfeoffment for parents were permitted.

s0047.literal: Monks and Daoists who transported their own grain were given honorific master titles.
s0047.idiomatic: Monks and Daoists who transported their own grain were given honorific master titles.

s0048.literal: Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang relief-sale grain prices in notes were levied and sent to the capital.
s0048.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe, Jiangxi, and Huguang relief-sale grain prices in notes were levied and sent to the capital.

s0049.literal: On jichou day, Tujian, Boqu, and others took Rendeh Prefecture; reaching Malong Prefecture, Eight Fan commander-in-chief Wanze led one thousand Eight Fan dalqan troops and five hundred Shun yuan native troops to resist them.
s0049.idiomatic: On jichou day, Tujian, Boqu, and others took Rendeh Prefecture; reaching Malong Prefecture, Eight Fan commander-in-chief Wanze led 1,000 Eight Fan dalqan troops and 500 Shun yuan native troops to resist them.

s0050.literal: On gengyin day, the three intendancies of Wansheng Youguo, Xinglong Puming, and Longxiang Wanshou were combined into the Construction Directorate-General, rank 4a;
s0050.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the 3 intendancies of Wansheng Youguo, Xinglong Puming, and Longxiang Wanshou were combined into the Construction Directorate-General, rank 4a;

s0051.literal: the eight intendancies including Wan'an Regulation Transport and Puqing Construction were combined into the Construction Directorate, rank 5a.
s0051.idiomatic: the 8 intendancies including Wan'an Regulation Transport and Puqing Construction were combined into the Construction Directorate, rank 5a.

s0052.literal: Because compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》 had long gone without success, Arin Temür, Qutlugh Durmish, and others of the Kui Zhang Pavilion were solely ordered to translate into Chinese the statutes recorded in the national language, while Zhao Shiyan, Yu Ji, and others would compile; Yan Temür was to supervise compilation as in the National History precedent.
s0052.idiomatic: Because compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》 had long gone without success, Arin Temür, Qutlugh Durmish, and others of the Kui Zhang Pavilion were solely ordered to translate into Chinese the statutes recorded in the national language, while Zhao Shiyan, Yu Ji, and others would compile; Yan Temür was to supervise compilation as in the National History precedent.

s0053.literal: Kaiyuan Route Huligai wanhu household troops suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
s0053.idiomatic: Kaiyuan Route Huligai wanhu household troops suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.

s0054.literal: On xinmao day, ten thousand ingots of censorate fine notes, one thousand taels of gold, and five thousand taels of silver were handed over to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings to supply sacrificial needs.
s0054.idiomatic: On xinmao day, 10,000 ingots of censorate fine notes, 1,000 taels of gold, and 5,000 taels of silver were handed over to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings to supply sacrificial needs.

s0055.literal: Yan Temür was granted relay-station sealed edicts to collect his fief rent and taxes.
s0055.idiomatic: Yan Temür was granted relay-station sealed edicts to collect his fief rent and taxes.

s0056.literal: On renchen day, Kui Zhang Pavilion academics Qutlugh Durmish, Sadi, and Yu Ji resigned; an edict instructed them: "In former times Our ancestors were wise, perceptive, and intelligent; as for the Way of bringing order, they naturally knew it by innate understanding.
s0056.idiomatic: On renchen day, Kui Zhang Pavilion academics Qutlugh Durmish, Sadi, and Yu Ji resigned; an edict instructed them: "In former times Our ancestors were wise, perceptive, and intelligent; as for the Way of bringing order, they naturally knew it by innate understanding.

s0057.literal: We, having received the succession upon this insignificant person, worry day and night; reflecting on Our early years of hardship and toil compared with Our ancestors, We lack their innate understanding — how can We thoroughly know the governing principles of the state?
s0057.idiomatic: We, having received the succession upon this insignificant person, worry day and night; reflecting on Our early years of hardship and toil compared with Our ancestors, We lack their innate understanding — how can We thoroughly know the governing principles of the state?

s0058.literal: Therefore the Kui Zhang Pavilion was established and academicians appointed, daily expounding before Us Our ancestors' enlightened instructions and the gains and losses of governance in antiquity, that We might delight in hearing them.
s0058.idiomatic: Therefore the Kui Zhang Pavilion was established and academicians appointed, daily expounding before Us Our ancestors' enlightened instructions and the gains and losses of governance in antiquity, that We might delight in hearing them.

s0059.literal: You and others should apply your learning to accord with Our intent, and do not resign again.
s0059.idiomatic: You and others should apply your learning to accord with Our intent, and do not resign again.

s0060.literal: " Temürchi relay households and Jiankang, Guangde, Zhenjiang, and other routes suffered famine; one month's grain was granted for relief.
s0060.idiomatic: " Temürchi relay households and Jiankang, Guangde, Zhenjiang, and other routes suffered famine; 1 month's grain was granted for relief.

s0061.literal: Weihui and Jiangzhou two routes suffered famine; twenty thousand ingots of notes were granted for relief.
s0061.idiomatic: Weihui and Jiangzhou 2 routes suffered famine; 20,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0062.literal: Ningguo Route suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of grain had been granted for relief, which was insufficient, and fifteen thousand shi more were granted.
s0062.idiomatic: Ningguo Route suffered famine; 20,000 shi of grain had been granted for relief, which was insufficient, and 15,000 shi more were granted.

s0063.literal: On guisi day, Weihui Route's Zuocheng and Xinxiang counties suffered great wind and rain disaster.
s0063.idiomatic: On guisi day, Weihui Route's Zuocheng and Xinxiang counties suffered great wind and rain disaster.

s0064.literal: On jiawu day, from gengyin to this day, the capital suffered heavy frost and excessive daytime rain.
s0064.idiomatic: On jiawu day, from gengyin to this day, the capital suffered heavy frost and excessive daytime rain.

s0065.literal: The Directorate-General for All Categories of Artisans, Hunters, and the Hawkery was established, rank 2a.
s0065.idiomatic: The Directorate-General for All Categories of Artisans, Hunters, and the Hawkery was established, rank 2a.

s0066.literal: Two Kui Zhang Pavilion supervising book erudites were appointed, rank 5a.
s0066.idiomatic: 2 Kui Zhang Pavilion supervising book erudites were appointed, rank 5a.

s0067.literal: Tujian, Boqu, and others attacked Jinning Prefecture; Tujian declared himself King of Yunnan, Boqu became chancellor, Ahe, Hulahu, and others became associate administrators and other offices; they built ramparts and burned storehouses to resist the command.
s0067.idiomatic: Tujian, Boqu, and others attacked Jinning Prefecture; Tujian declared himself King of Yunnan, Boqu became chancellor, Ahe, Hulahu, and others became associate administrators and other offices; they built ramparts and burned storehouses to resist the command.

s0068.literal: On yiwei day, the central secretariat said: "Jiang-Zhe people suffer famine; this year's sea transport is two million shi of rice; what is insufficient shall be supplemented by transport next year.
s0068.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the central secretariat said: "Jiang-Zhe people suffer famine; this year's sea transport is 2 million shi of rice; what is insufficient shall be supplemented by transport next year.

s0070.literal: On bingshen day, Yunnan Pu man came to court.
s0070.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Yunnan Pu man came to court.

s0071.literal: Changde and Lizhou routes suffered famine and were relieved.
s0071.idiomatic: Changde and Lizhou routes suffered famine and were relieved.

s0072.literal: On dingyou day, the Emperor, the empress, and Prince of Yan Alaqa Nadala all received Buddhist precepts.
s0072.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor, the empress, and Prince of Yan Alaqa Nadala all received Buddhist precepts.

s0073.literal: On jihai day, it was ordered that Mingzong's sons receive Buddhist precepts.
s0073.idiomatic: On jihai day, it was ordered that Mingzong's sons receive Buddhist precepts.

s0074.literal: A surveillance censor said: "Central secretariat associate administrator Duorzhi holds the office of the scales of the heavens, yet does not think to repay his duty; at the time of selection he disorders the regulations, his greed and corruption are well known, and he is shameless — dismissal is appropriate.
s0074.idiomatic: A surveillance censor said: "Central secretariat associate administrator Duorzhi holds the office of the scales of the heavens, yet does not think to repay his duty; at the time of selection he disorders the regulations, his greed and corruption are well known, and he is shameless — dismissal is appropriate.

s0076.literal: Yao bandits entered Guanyang County and plundered the people's property.
s0076.idiomatic: Yao bandits entered Guanyang County and plundered the people's property.

s0077.literal: On gengzi day, seals collected from princes Yesian Temür, Suosijian, and others because of military operations were returned to them.
s0077.idiomatic: On gengzi day, seals collected from princes Yesian Temür, Suosijian, and others because of military operations were returned to them.

s0078.literal: On renyin day, Yuelu Buhua resigned the post of censor-in-chief; the request was not granted.
s0078.idiomatic: On renyin day, Yuelu Buhua resigned the post of censor-in-chief; the request was not granted.

s0079.literal: The people of Tibetan territories suffered famine; the relevant offices were ordered to grant grain for relief.
s0079.idiomatic: The people of Tibetan territories suffered famine; the relevant offices were ordered to grant grain for relief.

s0080.literal: Xin'an, Baoding, and other relay stations' breeding livestock died of plague; the central secretariat was ordered to grant notes to relieve their want.
s0080.idiomatic: Xin'an, Baoding, and other relay stations' breeding livestock died of plague; the central secretariat was ordered to grant notes to relieve their want.

s0081.literal: On guimao day, Bianliang Route's Fengqiu and Xiangfu counties suffered frost disaster.
s0081.idiomatic: On guimao day, Bianliang Route's Fengqiu and Xiangfu counties suffered frost disaster.

s0082.literal: On jiachen day, the exiled Prince Shan's son was banished to Jiyang Circuit.
s0082.idiomatic: On jiachen day, the exiled Prince Shan's son was banished to Jiyang Circuit.

s0083.literal: On yisi day, Mingzong's son Yisinjinban was enfeoffed Prince of Fuzhou.
s0083.idiomatic: On yisi day, Mingzong's son Yisinjinban was enfeoffed Prince of Fuzhou.

s0084.literal: More than one thousand six hundred persons under Prince of Yu Alaqa Nadali suffered famine; two months' grain was granted for relief.
s0084.idiomatic: More than 1,600 persons under Prince of Yu Alaqa Nadali suffered famine; 2 months' grain were granted for relief.

s0085.literal: Huai'an Route people suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes were granted for relief.
s0085.idiomatic: Huai'an Route people suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of Liang-Huai salt-tax notes were granted for relief.

s0086.literal: On bingwu day, Arslan Qaya was again made Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.
s0086.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Arslan Qaya was again made Jiangnan Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.

s0087.literal: Central Court director Xiaoyunshi was ordered to take troops to suppress Yunnan.
s0087.idiomatic: Central Court director Xiaoyunshi was ordered to take troops to suppress Yunnan.

s0088.literal: Censorate officials said: "At the beginning of Tianli the Qipchaq Office was at Shangdu and often plotted with Kuokuochu and others to seize Toghancha'er; when the affair leaked out, the co-conspirators all died, but the Qipchaq Office was spared because of campaigning.
s0088.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "At the beginning of Tianli the Qipchaq Office was at Shangdu and often plotted with Kuokuochu and others to seize Toghancha'er; when the affair leaked out, the co-conspirators all died, but the Qipchaq Office was spared because of campaigning.

s0089.literal: Recently censorate members suspected and impeached them, but this did not fit the facts; their wrongful treatment should be cleared.
s0089.idiomatic: Recently censorate members suspected and impeached them, but this did not fit the facts; their wrongful treatment should be cleared.

s0091.literal: " On dingwei day, Bayan was made privy council administrator, retaining his former posts as grand preceptor and recorder of weighty military and state affairs.
s0091.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Bayan was made privy council administrator, retaining his former posts as grand preceptor and recorder of weighty military and state affairs.

s0092.literal: An edict instructed the central secretariat: "In former times under Shizu, a single chancellor was often made to take overall charge of all affairs, so that governance issued from one source and administration had a single head.
s0092.idiomatic: An edict instructed the central secretariat: "In former times under Shizu, a single chancellor was often made to take overall charge of all affairs, so that governance issued from one source and administration had a single head.

s0093.literal: Now Yan Temür is right chancellor and Bayan already holds the privy council; the left chancellorship should not be reappointed.
s0093.idiomatic: Now Yan Temür is right chancellor and Bayan already holds the privy council; the left chancellorship should not be reappointed.

s0094.literal: " Each directorate-general subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings was given one deputy darughachi.
s0094.idiomatic: Each directorate-general subordinate to the Grand Council for Imperial Blessings was given 1 deputy darughachi.

s0095.literal: The Prince of Yu's prince tutor was granted a gold tiger tally.
s0095.idiomatic: The Prince of Yu's prince tutor was granted a gold tiger tally.

s0096.literal: On wushen day, central secretariat and Hanlin National History Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.
s0096.idiomatic: On wushen day, central secretariat and Hanlin National History Academy officials were ordered to sacrifice to the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong.

s0097.literal: Grand Council for Imperial Blessings commissioner Abu Haiya was made central secretariat associate administrator; Shi Weiliang and associate administrator Heshang were ordered to take overall charge of matters raised in memorials.
s0097.idiomatic: Grand Council for Imperial Blessings commissioner Abu Haiya was made central secretariat associate administrator; Shi Weiliang and associate administrator Heshang were ordered to take overall charge of matters raised in memorials.

s0098.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "By old regulation, on New Year's Day and the Heavenly Longevity Festival, inner and outer offices each had congratulatory gifts; recently this was abolished.
s0098.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "By old regulation, on New Year's Day and the Heavenly Longevity Festival, inner and outer offices each had congratulatory gifts; recently this was abolished.

s0099.literal: Now Jiang-Zhe provincial officials say that the sagely grace is broadly impartial and shelter extends without bound, yet we have nothing with which to repay it; whenever we encounter celebratory rites, we present memorials offering congratulations — we request that the old regulation be restored as appropriate.
s0099.idiomatic: Now Jiang-Zhe provincial officials say that the sagely grace is broadly impartial and shelter extends without bound, yet we have nothing with which to repay it; whenever we encounter celebratory rites, we present memorials offering congratulations — we request that the old regulation be restored as appropriate.
